faq.q: What is a titanium pem bipolar plate?
faq.a: A titanium pem bipolar plate is a precision-machined hydrogen hardware component used in pem electrolyzer bipolar plate (grade 1, pt-coated). Manufactured from Grade 1 CP-Ti (Pt-coated) for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium pem bipolar plate?
faq.a: Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate is designed for pem electrolyzer bipolar plate (grade 1, pt-coated). The Grade 1 CP-Ti (Pt-coated) grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium pem bipolar plate manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium pem bipolar plate?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium pem bipolar plate?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
